pictures.scene: Jacopo Bassano, The Building of the Ark - the heaped timber and the sawn planks with the woman in the white chemise and red sleeves leaning over the grey ass, the man in the red cap and the worker in the pink coat bending to the workbench among the saws and axes and baskets, and the mountain and the tree standing above them, a song of ascents of Solomon, unless the LORD builds the house its builders labor in vain, unless the LORD protects the city its watchmen stand guard in vain
pictures.name: pd_bassano_bouwen

pictures.scene: Jean-Francois Millet, Woman Baking Bread - the woman in the yellow headcloth and the blue green bodice sliding a loaf on the long peel into the glowing mouth of the brick oven, the dark beams of the room above her, in vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat
pictures.name: pd_millet_brood

pictures.scene: Albert Anker, Schlafender Knabe im Heu - the boy asleep on his back in the bright hay with his arms flung out and his straw hat fallen beside him, the warm boards of the barn wall behind him, for He gives sleep to His beloved, children are indeed a heritage from the LORD
pictures.name: pd_anker_slaap

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Polish Rider - the young rider in the fur cap with the full quiver of arrows and the bow at his hip and the sabre at his side, riding the pale horse out over the rocky ground under a brown sky, and the fruit of the womb is His reward, like arrows in the hand of a warrior
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_pijlen

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, Children's Games - the whole town square filled with children at their games, the row of them astride the red railing, the crowd of girls in the middle of the square, the riders on each other's backs and the tug of war, and the hoops and the barrel in the foreground, so are children born in one's youth, blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_kinderen

pictures.scene: Charles Leickert, De oude poort - the sunlit brick archway of the old town gate with the market crowd showing through it, the woman with the basket on her head standing out in the road and the people gathered on either side under the stepped gables, he will not be put to shame when he confronts the enemies at the gate
pictures.name: pd_leickert_poort

lines.text: A song of ascents. Of Solomon.
Unless the LORD builds the house,
unless the LORD protects the city,
its watchmen stand guard in vain.
for He gives sleep to His beloved.
Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD,
and the fruit of the womb is His reward.
Like arrows in the hand of a warrior,
so are children born in one’s youth.
whose quiver is full of them.
He will not be put to shame
when he confronts the enemies at the gate.
